full_judgment: 6. Admittedly plaintiff No. 1 is the full brother of defendant Nos. 1 and 2, and plaintiff No. 2 is their full sister. Defendant No. 1, as plaintiff brought on 3-6-1970 a suit being Other Suit No. 47 of 1970 in the Court of the Sub-ordinate Judge at Rangpur for declaration of his 15 annas title to the disputed landed property measuring 30 acre at Mouza Kamal katchna within Rangpur Municipality with 4 huts and a building standing thereon, for khas possession of two huts described as schedule A2-A3 and part of the building described as schedule B2 and also for permanent injunction in respect of a Saw-Mill schedule C. In that suit the present plaintiffs were impleaded as defendant Nos. 3 and 4 while defendant No. 2 and their mother Mst. Zohimonnessa Bewa, now deceased, were defendant Nos. 2 and 1 respectively. After a contest for six years by defendant No. 2 the suit was decreed on 31-6-1976 on contest against him and ex-parte against the rest. Defendant No. 2 took an appeal therefrom being FA No, 230 of 1976 to the Supreme Court, High Court Division and a Division Bench of the High Court Division, Rangpur Bench dismissed the appeal on contest on 13.2.1984. Then again defendant No. 2 filed an application to the Supreme Court, Appellate Division for leave to appeal against the said judgment but without any success. After the disposal of the leave application the present suit has been instituted.
